Artifact.Name: Памятник Неизвестному Солдату Первого Поколения
Artifact.Description: A stone rectangle approximately as tall as an adult Wekkarus. Regal decorations of the ancient Wekkarus keep the monument upright and accent the stone’s engravings. Though quite heavy, an ancient gravity reduction device is affixed to the Cenotaph’s base, promoting portability. Many who are near this artifact report feelings of competence and safety.\n\nIn addition this artifact will double the chance of Ancestors Among Us ghost character events (when owned by a Wekkarus faction).

Artifact.Name: Корабль предков
Artifact.Description: A tabletop model of an ancient Wekkarus vehicle which adventurers used to explore the Wekkarus homeworld beyond the oceans. It is made of an unknown metal, darker blue in color though certain kinds of light reveal it is marbled with hues of lighter blue inscriptions, creating the impression of an ocean surface.\n\nIn addition this artifact will double the chance of Ancestors Among Us ghost ship appearance (when owned by a Wekkarus faction).

Artifact.Name: Сфера Силы Предков
Artifact.Description: This is a metal sphere, small enough to hold. Tapping on it suggests it is hollow, but the sphere is nevertheless curiously heavy. All who hold is report seeing mental images of ground combat. These are strong impressions rather than full hallucinations.\n\nIn addition this artifact will double the chance of Ancestors Among Us ghost troop appearance (when owned by a Wekkarus faction).

Artifact.Name: Сводный свод разрушителей
Artifact.Description: Древний артефакт Веккаруса. Несмотря на обугленность и сколы, этот кристалл данных в основном цел и полностью функционален. Поскольку он был создан древними Веккарусом, его размеры не точно соответствуют современной технологии. Тем не менее, благодаря средствам, которые наши учёные считают непостижимыми, он способен взаимодействовать с нашими компьютерными системами. Древний кристалл данных Веккаруса, каким-то образом подключённый к компьютеру. Кристалл имеет признаки повреждений.
